items.title: John "Picky" Brunious Interview, 1959-05-26
items.q: I worked with Herbert Leverett's band, too. Yeah. Well, Herbert had a, he had a nice band, also.

ctx.x: Well, that was about all, I know one thing. Well, that's all right.

Yeah, well, I know one thing, Sidney used to cut you a lot, too, man. You see, at that time, man, Jobs used to pay $3. You know? And, uh, well, each man in the band used to get $3, man, sure. Sidney said, well, man, you see, and people said, man, you see for yourself. You know? That was a very saying, a very famous saying at that time, you know? Like if you go play a dance, you know? People say, and just very, maybe about four or five people would come to the dance. And then when the time come to pay off, now you…
When did you first start playing on the streets? What do you mean on the streets?
